name: What measurements or info do you need before starting a wainscoting job?

mainEntity.name: What measurements or info do you need before starting a wainscoting job?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, accurate measurements matter a lot because panel spacing, chair-rail height, and corner treatment all affect the finished look. Installers should measure the room, mark the wall with a level, and plan for consistent spacing so the design does not look off once it is painted.
acceptedAnswer.description: Room dimensions, ceiling height, wall condition, and the locations of doors, windows, and outlets are the basics. Good measurements help the installer keep the layout balanced and avoid surprises.
